data.title: AEON Launches Agentic Checkout, Powered by AI Card for Autonomous Commerce
data.description:
AEON Launches Agentic Checkout, Powered by AI Card for Autonomous Commerce

AEON Launches Agentic Checkout, Powered by AI Card for Autonomous Commerce

PR Newswire

HONG KONG, Sept. 4, 2026

HONG KONG, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AEON, the settlement layer built for the AI economy, has launched Agentic Checkout, enabling AI agents to autonomously shop, check out, and pay across e-commerce platforms such as Shopify and Amazon. Powered by the AEON AI Card, Agentic Checkout gives agents controlled spending capabilities to turn user intent into completed purchases.

Natively integrated with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), Agentic Checkout allows users to interact with an AI agent through a conversational interface, describe what they are looking for, and let the agent search for suitable products and build a shopping cart based on their requirements.

Once a product is selected, the user can authorize the purchase with an AEON AI Card settled over the Visa/Mastercard networks, allowing the agent to complete the transaction without exposing the user's primary payment credentials or treasury wallet. The agent can move from product discovery to cart creation and payment, turning a natural-language request into a completed purchase.

AI Card: Giving AI Agents Controlled Spending Power

At the core of this experience is the AEON AI Card, designed to give AI agents financial autonomy while keeping spending under defined controls. 

The infrastructure supports single-use agent cards and predefined budget limits, allowing spending authority to be scoped to individual tasks or transactions. Backed by crypto-based authorization and connected to existing Visa payment infrastructure, the AI Card creates a bridge between on-chain assets and everyday commerce.

This allows agents to spend on behalf of users without requiring direct access to their primary wallets or traditional credit cards, bringing agentic commerce closer to a model where AI can not only assist users with decisions, but also securely execute those decisions in the real economy. 

Agentic Checkout to Bigger Commerce Ecosystem

Agentic Checkout is designed to give AI agents access to an open commerce ecosystem, rather than a limited list of curated merchants. Through Shopify, agents can search across 3M+ active storefronts in 175+ countries and more than a billion products, spanning categories including apparel, home, beauty, electronics, and books.

Shopify is one of the first environments where AEON's Agentic Checkout capability is being demonstrated, but the underlying infrastructure is designed to extend across e-commerce ecosystems and support both physical and digital goods. Amazon and Travala are next, bringing mass-market retail and travel inventory into the same agent interface.

The infrastructure is also designed with the safeguards required for production use. Full card numbers and security codes never enter conversation logs or model context, while uncertain payment states are verified before any retry to prevent silent double charges.

As more commerce platforms become accessible to AI agents, the ability to securely authorize and settle these transactions will become increasingly important. AEON Agentic Checkout and AI Card provides the financial execution layer that allows agents to act within defined spending boundaries. And AEON is building the settlement infrastructure to enable these agents to transact, pay, and settle securely across the digital and physical economies.

Building the Settlement Layer for the AI Economy

The Agentic Checkout and AI Card represent two connected components of AEON's agentic payment infrastructure: Agentic Checkout gives agents the ability to execute commerce, while AI Card gives them controlled financial authority to pay for it. Together, they connect agent intent, payment authorization, checkout execution, and settlement into a unified flow.

AI agents are increasingly capable of searching, reasoning, coordinating tasks, and making decisions on behalf of users. The next step is enabling those decisions to result in secure, verifiable economic transactions. AEON is building toward this infrastructure by combining agent identity, payment authorization, checkout execution, and settlement into a unified framework for the AI economy, enabling AI agents to transact across digital and physical economies, autonomously, securely, and within clearly defined financial boundaries.

About AEON

AEON is the native settlement layer built for the AI economy. By equipping agents with a comprehensive suite of programmable payment primitives, spanning across Agent Account, AI Card, AI Gateway, and more, AEON empowers autonomous AI to seamlessly navigate global value networks. Designed to eliminate the fee overhead, programmability gaps, and settlement lag of legacy infrastructure, AEON provides the universal financial rails needed for agents to enter the global economy across any currency, chain, or protocol.

Natively integrating with leading standards like x402, ERC-8004, MCP, and Google A2A, AEON enables verifiable AI payments at scale and connects agentic capabilities directly to a network of 50M+ global merchants. Having processed over $514M in cumulative volume for 2.3M+ users, AEON is backed by top investors including YZi Labs, IDG Capital, HashKey Capital, and the Stanford Blockchain Builders Fund. The $AEON token is live on major global exchanges including OKX, Bitget, Binance Alpha and Bithumb.

data.title: Generational Group Advises RMH Solutions in its Sale to a Private Investor Group
data.description:
Generational Group Advises RMH Solutions in its Sale to a Private Investor Group

Generational Group, a leading mergers and acquisitions advisory firm for privately held businesses, is pleased to announce the sale of RMH Solutions, a Cambridge, Ontario-based material handling equipment and service provider specializing in cranes, hoists, and related industrial equipment to a Private Investor Group. The acquisition closed August 13, 2026.

Headquartered in Cambridge, Ontario, Canada, RMH Solutions is a material handling equipment and service provider that has supplied cranes, hoists, and related equipment to industrial clients since 1984. The company serves Cambridge, Kitchener/Waterloo, Guelph, Stratford, Brantford, and the surrounding communities of Southwestern Ontario and the Western GTA. RMH supports clients through:

  • Supplying and installing overhead cranes, jib cranes, workstation cranes, and hoisting systems for industrial facilities
  • Providing service, inspection, and parts support to keep existing equipment running safely and reliably
  • Offering consulting and engineering services for custom installations and complex material handling challenges
  • Training operators to safely and effectively run crane and hoist equipment

The company has built its reputation on practical solutions, reliable service, and fast response times, with experienced technicians equipped to handle complex installations at competitive rates.

Generational Group Executive Managing Director, M&A, Eastern Region – David Fergusson, and his team led by Senior Managing Director, M&A, Mike Hammer with the support of Managing Director, M&A, Corey Painter successfully closed the deal. Executive Managing Director, Tom Stephens and Senior M&A Advisor, Bryce Gray established the initial relationship with RMH Solutions.

Ryan Binkley, CEO of Generational Group, stated, “This partnership positions the company for an exciting period of continued development. We are confident the team has the experience and resources needed to build on its accomplishments and pursue the opportunities ahead.”

About Generational Group

Generational Group, headquartered in Dallas, TX, is a leading, award winning full-service M&A advisory firm. Generational has over 350 professionals across 17 offices in North America. The firm empowers business owners to unlock the full value of their companies through a comprehensive suite of services—including M&A advisory, exit planning education, business valuation, strategic growth advisory, wealth advisory, and digital solutions.

Celebrating its 21st year, Generational has successfully closed over 1,900 transactions and has ranked #1 or #2 in all LSEG league tables for deals valued between $25 million and $1 billion in 2024 and 2025.

The firm was named 2025 USA Investment Banking Firm of the Year by the Global M&A Network and recognized as Investment Banking Firm of the Year by The M&A Advisor in 2024 and 2025.

data.title: Primero Games Acquires Win Systems Gaming Division, Expanding International Reach
data.description:
Primero Games Acquires Win Systems Gaming Division, Expanding International Reach

Primero Games Acquires Win Systems Gaming Division, Expanding International Reach

PR Newswire

NORCROSS, Ga., Sept. 4, 2026

Acquisition adds slot and electronic-roulette products, manufacturing capabilities and an installed base of more than 3,000 gaming positions across Latin America and the Caribbean.

NORCROSS, Ga., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Primero Games LLC ("Primero"), a provider of gaming content, technology and products, today announced the acquisition of the Gaming Division of Win Systems ("WSG"), including its Gold Club electronic-roulette business.

The acquisition expands Primero's international presence and product portfolio, adding established slot and electronic-roulette products, manufacturing capabilities and gaming operations across Latin America and the Caribbean. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

The acquired operations have an installed base of more than 3,000 gaming positions in Mexico, Peru, Colombia, Puerto Rico, and Panama. Primero will support existing customers and products while introducing additional Primero game content, platform technology and development resources.

"This is an important step forward in executing Primero's growth strategy to build a diversified, global gaming company," said Mike Macke, Chairman of Primero Games. "Primero has built its reputation by creating compelling game content and developing innovative technology that helps operators deliver consistent revenue via engaging player experiences."

"We are excited to welcome Eric Benchimol, Dario Zutel, and the talented WSG team to Primero," Macke continued. "By combining Primero's content and development expertise with WSG's products, operations and customer relationships, we can deliver more products, more content and greater value to customers across a wider range of gaming markets."

"This combination makes both businesses stronger," said Eric Benchimol, CEO of Win Systems. "Pairing our installed base, manufacturing operations and market knowledge with Primero's game library and development engine means we can bring more, and better, products to our customers faster than either company could alone. The team is energized, and we're looking forward to getting to work as part of Primero."

"This transaction marks an exciting new chapter for our Gaming Division," said Dario Zutel, Executive Chairman of Win Systems. "We are confident that Primero Games is the right partner to build on what we have achieved and drive the business into its next stage of international growth."

Building International Scale

Primero has an established presence in U.S. gaming markets, with a portfolio that includes game content, online gaming solutions, redemption kiosks, and a mature omnichannel gaming platform.  The WSG acquisition adds established products, manufacturing capabilities and long-standing customer relationships in international markets.

The WSG teams and infrastructure will continue to support customers in Mexico, Peru, Colombia, Puerto Rico, Panama and many other countries around the world. Primero and WSG are committed to providing continuity for every customer as Primero invests in the business and introduces additional products, content and technology.

About Primero Games

Primero Games is a leading provider of innovative games, platforms and products designed to deliver engaging player experiences and value to gaming operators across land-based and digital environments. Founded by gaming-industry veteran Mike Macke, Primero has made significant investment in its Hurricane gaming platform to support international expansion. The Hurricane platform is designed to support offline, online, single, and multi-game applications across emerging and regulated gaming markets. Primero's Spark server-based gaming solution extends the Hurricane platform by offering value-added features such as business intelligence, linked and wide-area progressive jackpots, game content subscription features, and player marketing/retention.

Headquartered in the United States, the company designs, manufactures and markets a portfolio of more than 100 original titles for land-based and multi-game platforms, as well as online games for markets worldwide. With studios in the U.S., the U.K., and Canada, Primero combines international creative talent with deep technical expertise to produce high-performing, scalable gaming solutions. For more information, visit www.primerogames.com.

About Win Systems

Win Systems is a global technology company with extensive experience providing innovative solutions to the gaming industry. Through its international operations and long-standing customer relationships, the company specializes in casino management systems and has a strong track record of delivering technology and solutions to operators across multiple markets worldwide. Following the transaction, Win Systems will continue to focus on its remaining businesses and strategic opportunities, building on its technology expertise, international experience, and commitment to delivering value to its customers and partners.

data.title: 'I didn't know what I didn't know': I thought I'd have to depend on Social Security. Then I taught myself how to invest.
data.description:
By Quentin Fottrell

'It always baffled me how some people managed to retire with significant wealth'

"I honestly wish more personal-finance education were mandatory in high school." (Photo subject is a model.)

Dear Quentin,

I'm a chef who is in the process of switching careers. I plan to pursue the Enrolled Agent credential. I'm also an avid investor. About four years ago, I started studying everything I could about investing and personal finance. I also encouraged my sister to do the same.

For most of my life, I had no idea that building wealth and having a positive net worth was something I could realistically achieve. I genuinely thought I was destined to depend almost entirely on Social Security in retirement. Now I know that doesn't have to be my reality.

I've also built an emergency fund. It's relatively small in dollar terms, but it covers about six months of my monthly expenses, which gives me some peace of mind. I'm incredibly glad I decided to educate myself financially, and even happier that I decided to go back to school.

The funny thing is that I didn't know what I didn't know. It wasn't until I got myself into some serious debt that I finally became willing to learn about personal finance. I was never taught anything about stocks, bonds, index funds - or investing in general.

I only knew about a basic savings account; I didn't even know high-yield savings accounts existed. Because of that, it always baffled me how some people managed to retire with significant wealth. I simply couldn't understand how they did it.

Now, having learned about investing, retirement accounts, taxes and the power of compounding, it's incredibly comforting to know that I have a path forward. And I'm going to keep learning, because financial education has genuinely become a major interest of mine.

My wife is willing to learn and build a better future. I honestly wish more personal-finance education were mandatory in high school. Not everyone goes to college, yet financial decisions affect every single person throughout their lives.

The Late-Blooming Investor

Related: 'We're living the simple life': I was a fisherman and my wife was a nurse. We retired with $6 million. Here's how we did it.

You can email The Moneyist with any financial and ethical questions at qfottrell@marketwatch.com. The Moneyist regrets he cannot reply to questions individually.

The FinEd50 coalition, a movement backed by both nonprofits and corporations, is working to expand and improve financial education.

Dear Late Blooming,

You have cooked up something remarkable. You started with almost no financial knowledge, climbed out of serious debt and used that experience as motivation to turn your life around. You taught yourself about investing, the power of compounding - where your principal and the interest earned on that principal make money - taxes and, finally, retirement accounts. Not only that, you built a six-month emergency fund, went back to school and are pursuing a role as an EA. Not content with that, you're spreading the word among your family. Bravo.

Believe it or not, 39 states require personal-finance lessons for high school graduates, according to the Council for Economic Education Survey of the States. Not all are standalone courses. Four states - California, Delaware, Colorado and Hawaii - are now mandating that students take a semester-long personal-finance course before graduating. "Additionally, Kentucky and Texas strengthened their existing policies transitioning from embedded personal finance content within other courses to dedicated stand-alone courses."

However, approximately 22 states require economics for graduation, although some states, including Texas and California, replaced economics requirements with personal finance. Experts say that personal finance and economics should both be taught, given that finance focuses on practical money skills while economics develops understanding of markets, policies and broader financial systems. The FinEd50 coalition, a movement backed by both nonprofits and corporations, is working to expand and improve financial education.

The secret to having a comfortable retirement? There is no secret, really, more than a succession of small steps.

That progress is not entirely reflected in the number of working adults with a retirement plan. Roughly 40% of Americans report that they do not have any money invested in a retirement savings plan like a 401(k), 403(b) or IRA, either alone or even with a spouse, per a May 2026 poll from Gallup. The more you earn, the more likely you are to have a retirement plan, because you will have a job with a company that more likely offers a 401(k) with an employer match, and because you're not living paycheck to paycheck.

Roughly 83% of adults with at least $100,000 in annual household income have a retirement-savings plan, significantly higher than the 28% rate among those in households earning less than $50,000 a year, Gallup says. More revealing and to your point about education: 81% of college graduates compared with 39% of adults with no college education have a retirement-savings plan. Some 68% of non-Hispanic white adults have a retirement savings plan versus 42% of people of color. Men (61%) are also more likely than women (57%) to have a plan.

There is, as you have experienced, a gap between the number of personal-finance courses in high schools and the number of people actually implementing those lessons. The reasons are complex: Not every student has access to such classes, but even when they do, they're not always standalone classes, and the quality of the teaching, as with all high schools, varies. Add to that underfunding for schools, a shortage of sufficiently trained teachers, and bias among schools when it comes to more traditional subjects. A shift in thinking takes years, if not generations.

The secret to having a comfortable retirement? There is no secret, really, more than a succession of small steps and, as far as education and career goes, good fortune. Attending college is expensive, and not everyone can afford to give themselves that kind of start in life, despite the $1.86 trillion in student debt held by millions of American graduates (and some nongraduates). Start saving early, but know that it's often never too late, even if you haven't started by your 30s or 40s. There is also a fine line between sensible budgeting and sacrifice.

You are a powerful example for others. It's never too late to turn your finances around.

data.title: UNIONS NEEDED NOW MORE THAN EVER
data.description:
UNIONS NEEDED NOW MORE THAN EVER 

“Attacks on working people over the last year show us that Albertans need strong unions now more than ever,” says CUPE Alberta President Raj Uppal.

“The annual celebration of Labour Day across Alberta gives us the opportunity to reflect upon and celebrate the working folks who make our province run.

“A one-day strike at WestJet last month was enough to show what united workers can achieve. Corporations continue to unfairly rake in record profits on the backs of workers. This is not only unfair; it’s ultimately bad for the economy of Canada. Because when folks are working harder for less, the result is a slowdown in our economy.”

Uppal referenced a recent report by Jim Stanford, a celebrated Canadian economist, which shows that while corporate profits have soared in Alberta since the UCP has taken power, the purchasing power of the average worker has stagnated. The so-called Alberta Advantage has completely disappeared.

“And Danielle Smith and her UCP Government are paving the way to make our situation worse by raising the prospect of separation. By remaining uncommitted to fully embracing Canada, she is creating an environment of uncertainty that has already impacted Albertans and working people are already suffering.

“And then she includes nine other questions that are racist and/or unconstitutional. CUPE Alberta is advocating to its members to choose to remain in Canada and to vote NO to the other nine questions.”

Uppal points to unions leading the defence against the worst of Premier Smith’s ideological initiatives. “Whether it is standing up against the UCP’s attempts to illegally introduce American-styled two-tier health care to Alberta, to further privatize our public school system or to infringe on the rights of our children through draconian regulations over what they read and how they present themselves, it’s unions that are leading the way.

“This is no time to back down,” she concluded. “The UCP need to know that the fight is just beginning. And we will never let them win.”

data.title: MMRO Earns URAC Artificial Intelligence in Health Care Accreditation
data.description:
MMRO Earns URAC Artificial Intelligence in Health Care Accreditation

MMRO Earns URAC Artificial Intelligence in Health Care Accreditation

PR Newswire

NOVI, Mich., Sept. 4, 2026

Accreditation affirms MMRO's commitment to responsible AI governance, human oversight, and clinical integrity.

NOVI, Mich., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Managed Medical Review Organization, Inc. (MMRO) is proud to announce that it has earned the Artificial Intelligence in Health Care Accreditation (Version 1.0) from URAC, the nation's leading independent health care accreditation organization. URAC's Artificial Intelligence in Health Care Accreditation is the first accreditation program in the nation to establish trusted standards for the responsible use and development of artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare.

Over the past year, MMRO has worked diligently to develop a comprehensive AI governance program from the ground up, with responsible use policies, risk and impact assessments that consider the unique challenges that AI presents to data security, and testing and training requirements all aligned with, and guided by, URAC's rigorous framework. This includes formal clinical oversight by MMRO's Vice President of Clinical Programs, Jen Mongeau, DHA, MBA, MSN, RN.

"This accreditation was the result of a full year of preparation and effort, and our team should be incredibly proud," said Douglas Minke, J.D., M.B.A., Vice President of Corporate Development and General Counsel, and MMRO's Chief Information Security Officer. "We now have a governance program that lets us look at new AI technology through a clear lens: does it protect the information we review and the people we serve, and does it uphold the standard of clinical excellence our clients count on? If the answer is not yes to both, it does not move forward."

Armed with this URAC Accreditation, MMRO will continue the evaluation of AI solutions that can aid in the efficient and clinically accurate provision of services to its clients. In doing so, MMRO is committed to the responsible and compliant use of AI technology. AI solutions will not be used to provide clinical judgments, determine medical necessity, or issue clinical determinations or recommendations; replace regulatory or legal review; nor act as an autonomous decisionmaker for adverse actions affecting members/claimants/patients, providers, or employees.

"Growth Through Quality is more than a motto here, it is how we make decisions," said Joe Schimizzi, President and CEO of MMRO. "Our organization is a reflection of our staff and the expertise, care, commitment, and clinical excellence they bring to their work every single day. Obtaining the Artificial Intelligence in Health Care Accreditation from URAC ensures that as we grow and incorporate AI technology into our operations, clinical quality is the one thing we will never compromise."

This Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare Accreditation compliments MMRO's continued URAC accreditation as an Independent Review Organization (IRO), which it has held for more than 15 years.

About MMRO

Managed Medical Review Organization, Inc. (MMRO), headquartered in Novi, Michigan, provides independent medical review services supported by one of the largest networks of licensed physicians and clinical professionals in the industry. Guided by its commitment to Growth Through Quality, MMRO delivers timely, defensible, and clinically sound reviews with an uncompromising focus on security, compliance, and service excellence. Visit us online at www.mmroinc.com

data.title: Western Computer Achieves the 2026/2027 Microsoft AI Business Solutions Inner Circle Award
data.description:
Western Computer Achieves the 2026/2027 Microsoft AI Business Solutions Inner Circle Award

Western Computer Achieves the 2026/2027 Microsoft AI Business Solutions Inner Circle Award

PR Newswire

CHICAGO, Sept. 4, 2026

Western Computer is honored by Microsoft for achieving outstanding sales achievement and innovation.

CHICAGO, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Western Computer, a Microsoft solutions partner delivering Dynamics 365 ERP, Microsoft 365, and AI-powered business applications, today announced its selection to the 2026/2027 Microsoft AI Business Solutions Inner Circle award. Participation within Inner Circle is based on sales achievements that rank Western Computer in the top echelon of Microsoft's AI Business Solutions global network of partners. It's widely acknowledged that Inner Circle members perform at a high-level by delivering valuable and innovative solutions that help organizations excel.

This is the third consecutive year Western Computer has been named to the Inner Circle, the longest streak in the company's history.

Inner Circle members are invited to the Inner Circle Summit in Spring 2027 as well as virtual meetings between September 2026 and June 2027, where they will have a unique opportunity to discuss strategy with Microsoft executives and fellow Inner Circle partners, while learning more about the Microsoft's road maps and future plans, establish strong executive connections, and collaborate on best practices.

"The first year of Inner Circle membership tells you that you had a good year," said Kristen Sage, CEO of Western Computer. "Three years in a row tells you something different. It means customers are getting real results, and they keep coming back. That's what our team should be proud of. We've spent nearly 40 years helping distribution, manufacturing, and wine and spirits companies get more out of their systems, and today that work runs through AI. Inner Circle gives us Microsoft's roadmap early, so we can help customers determine what's worth adopting now and what can wait."

"Inner Circle partners represent our top selling partners worldwide. But it is more than a sales recognition; it's a community of industry leaders who work closely with Microsoft to accelerate innovation, share experience and shape the future of AI-powered business transformation. The collaboration and commitment to customer success demonstrated by this community helps us advance the entire AI Business Solutions partner ecosystem around the world to deliver transformative business outcomes at scale," said Niels Jensen, Microsoft AI Business Solutions ERP Lead in Enterprise Partner Solutions.

The recognition reflects Western Computer's work across four areas:

  • Cloud ERP modernization. Moving customers off Dynamics NAV, GP, and AX and onto Dynamics 365 Business Central and Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management.
  • AI and Copilot adoption. Putting Microsoft Copilot and agents to work inside ERP and day-to-day operations, so teams spend less time chasing data and more time acting on it.
  • Industry depth. Purpose-built solutions for wine and spirits, remanufacturing, distribution, and manufacturing built from decades of work on the warehouse floor and in the month-end close.
  • Modern Work and Managed Support Services. Microsoft 365, Client Infrastructure Services, and Managed Support Services that keep systems healthy long after go-live.

About Western Computer

Western Computer is a Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) founded in 1987 to empower and enable businesses. Specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions, services, and support, our 150+ senior-level experts bring advanced functional and industry expertise to companies across North America. With nearly 40 years of ERP, CRM, and business intelligence experience, and more than 1,750 successful implementations, we deliver solutions to meet the unique needs of distributors and manufacturers of all sizes.

data.title: CHICKEN SALAD CHICK CELEBRATES 11TH MISSISSIPPI LOCATION WITH BRANDON OPENING
data.description:
CHICKEN SALAD CHICK CELEBRATES 11TH MISSISSIPPI LOCATION WITH BRANDON OPENING

CHICKEN SALAD CHICK CELEBRATES 11TH MISSISSIPPI LOCATION WITH BRANDON OPENING

PR Newswire

ATLANTA, Sept. 4, 2026

Fast‑casual concept hosts grand opening on September 15 with free chicken salad for a year

ATLANTA, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Chicken Salad Chick, the nation's only fast-casual chicken salad restaurant concept, announced today the opening of its 11th restaurant in The Magnolia State, located at 1480 West Government Street. The local community is invited to celebrate this grand opening on Tuesday, September 15 when the first 100 guests in line will win free chicken salad for a year*. 

During the grand opening week, guests will experience the Southern hospitality Chicken Salad Chick is known for while taking advantage of various specials and giveaways. These include:

  • Tuesday, September 15 – Free Chicken Salad for a Year to the First 100 Guests – The first guest in line at 10:30am will receive one FREE large Quick Chick of chicken salad per week for an entire year. The next 99 guests in line will receive one FREE large Quick Chick of chicken salad per month for a year!*
  • Wednesday, September 16 – The first 50 guests at 10:30am and 5pm to purchase a meal with two sides will receive a FREE Chick Tumbler!**
  • Thursday, September 17 – The first 50 guests at 10:30am and 5pm to purchase a meal with two sides will receive a FREE Meal Card!**
  • Friday, September 18 – The first 50 guests at 10:30am and 5pm to purchase two Large Quick Chicks will receive a FREE Chick cooler! ***
  • Saturday, September 19 – The first 50 guests at 10:30am and 5pm to purchase a meal with two sides will receive a FREE Chick Tote Bag!**

Chicken Salad Chick of Brandon is owned and operated by multi-unit franchise owners, Shae and Blake Fuller. The couple began their Chicken Salad Chick journey in 2018 with the opening of their first location in Flowood and have steadily expanded their footprint ever since – adding restaurants in Madison, Hattiesburg, and most recently Ridgeland. Proud of the brand's heritage and its commitment to serving others with fresh, made‑from‑scratch chicken salad, the Fullers remain focused on sustained growth and look forward to bringing even more locations to communities across Mississippi.

"Reaching our fifth opening is something I'm incredibly proud of," said Blake Keller, co-owner of Chicken Salad Chick of Brandon. "Brandon has embraced Chicken Salad Chick in such a meaningful way, and we're grateful for the trust this community has placed on us. Our goal is always to create a place where guests feel at home, and we can't wait to welcome even more families through our doors."

Chicken Salad Chick is known for its dozen-plus variety of made-from-scratch chicken salad flavors, fresh sides, gourmet soups, signature sandwiches, and desserts. The new Brandon restaurant offers in-restaurant dining, drive-thru, take-out, third-party delivery, and catering options.

"We're excited to celebrate Blake and Shae's fifth Chicken Salad Chick opening here in Brandon," said Scott Deviney, CEO and president of Chicken Salad Chick. "This community is an ideal place for us to continue growing the brand and introducing more guests to our fresh, made‑from‑scratch favorites. Blake and Shae have built something special across Mississippi, and we look forward to seeing their impact as Chicken Salad Chick becomes Brandon's go‑to spot for great food and genuine hospitality."

Giving back to the community is an important focus for the Brandon team and the Chicken Salad Chick brand, which established the CSC Foundation to support CURE Childhood Cancer and local food banks with fundraisers throughout the year. As part of pre-opening Friends & Family events in Brandon, the restaurant will be raising money for Children's Hospital of Mississippi. This is the state's only hospital exclusively dedicated to the care of babies, children, and young adults.

Chicken Salad Chick of Brandon will be open Monday – Saturday from 10:30am – 8pm. For more information on giveaways and specials, visit the Brandon restaurant's Facebook. Visit www.chickensaladchick.com, and follow Chicken Salad Chick on Facebook and Instagram for the latest news and trends. 

*Guests should arrive early to secure a place in line. The first 100 guests must remain in line and download the Chicken Salad Chick app. Wi-Fi will not be available on site. Once the restaurant opens, guests will make a purchase of a meal with two sides, or anything of equal/greater value and enter a code in the Chicken Salad Chick app to officially secure their spot. If you leave the line for any reason, your spot will be awarded to the next guest in line. Guests will receive their first free large Quick Chick electronically to their app the Monday following Grand Opening Day. Your reward will be valid for redemption for 30 days upon delivery. Guest must be 16 years or older. Not valid with any other offers. Limit 1 reward per guest present.

**Guest must be 16 years or older and purchase a meal with two sides. Limit 1 reward per guest present. Not valid with any other offers. In-restaurant only.

*** Guest must be 16 years or older and purchase two Large Quick Chicks. Limit 1 reward per guest present. Not valid with any other offers. In-restaurant only.

About Chicken Salad Chick 
Chicken Salad Chick serves full-flavored, Southern-style chicken salad made from scratch and served from the heart. With more than a dozen original chicken salad flavors plus fresh sides, soups, sandwiches, desserts and catering, there's something for every guest and occasion. Chicken Salad Chick has grown to more than 345 restaurants across 25 states and continues its rapid expansion driven by a passionate network of franchise owners. The brand has earned consistent recognition from Entrepreneur, Franchise Times, Fast Casual, QSR, Southern Living, USA Today and Technomic, among others. Visit www.chickensaladchick.com to learn more.

data.title: King Resources Global, Inc. (OTCQB: KRFG) Subsidiary Heavenly Grace Limited Acquires 23 Collectible Items Valued at $68.9 Million

King Resources Global, Inc. (OTCQB: KRFG) Subsidiary Heavenly Grace Limited Acquires 23 Collectible Items Valued at $68.9 Million

King Resources Global, Inc. (OTCQB: KRFG) Subsidiary Heavenly Grace Limited Acquires 23 Collectible Items Valued at $68.9 Million

PR Newswire

HONG KONG, Sept. 4, 2026

HONG KONG, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- King Resources Global, Inc. (OTCQB: KRFG) ("KRFG" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that its wholly owned subsidiary, Heavenly Grace Limited ("HGL"), has entered into a purchase agreement with Herbertini Limited to acquire twenty-three (23) collectible items.

Transaction Highlights

The collection has been independently valued at an aggregate amount of $68,908,500. Under the terms of the purchase agreement, HGL will acquire the collection for $23,399,165, representing approximately 33.96% of the appraised value.

Management Commentary

"We are pleased to have successfully negotiated the acquisition of these collectible items at what we believe is an attractive purchase price," said Polin Wong, Chief Executive Officer of Heavenly Grace Limited. "This transaction reflects our continued commitment to identifying opportunities within the collectibles market and enhancing the value of our investment portfolio."

The Company also recently completed its reincorporation from Delaware to Nevada and now operates under the name King Resources Global, Inc.

About King Resources Global, Inc.

King Resources Global, Inc. (OTCQB: KRFG) is a diversified holding company focused on acquiring, developing, and growing high-potential businesses. Through its subsidiaries, including Heavenly Grace Limited, the Company seeks to generate sustainable revenue streams and create long-term shareholder value through business consulting services and investments in high-value collectible assets.
